nota: [ESC f535] SEP7: how often does tp_sep=4.5 lift the R hem at the CF, and does the facing lever avoid it. SEP5: 2 of 7 sep45 replicas lifted it (sep45_3 zR 816 vs zL 798; sep45_4 zR 835, 24 placket x fcR cuts), sep45fa N=3 did not. sep45fa_3..12 = bi_k 1.003-1.012 (N=13 with m133_sep5 sep45fa_0..2); sep45_7..15 = bi_k 1.007-1.015 (N=16 with sep45_0..6 of m133_sep/m133_sep5). Identity: sep45id_1 (bi_k 1.004) must equal m133_sep5--sep45_4 bit for bit. Group bp, base bvp_w=10 ruedo_vivo=30 ruedo_vivo_relleno=0 tp_sep=4.5, nf 80. No new lever.
